title: 第26章 震撼一波接着一波！
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
还是说，他以我们无法理解的方式，“活”在了这口玉棺里，直到今天？

    她不敢再想下去。

    “准备靠近玉棺。”

    她对着身后的队员们，下达了可能是她这辈子最艰难，也最激动人心的一个命令。

    “林薇队长决定靠近玉棺！这是一个历史性的时刻！我们或许即将亲眼见证一个流传千年的秘密被揭开！”

    演播厅里，主持人冰冰的声音因为激动而显得有些高亢。

    屏幕前的数亿观众，此刻也都屏住了呼吸，连弹幕都变得稀疏了许多。

    所有人的心，都随着林薇和队员们的脚步，一点点地提到了嗓子眼。

    那座九层高台，有着无形的魔力。

    随着林队和队员们一步步向上攀登，周围的光芒越来越盛，空气中那股让人神清气爽的“生命能量”也越来越浓郁。

    队员们甚至能感觉到，自己身上的一些小伤口，竟然在以肉眼可见的速度愈合。

    【卧槽！自动回血！这地方也太神了！】

    【这哪里是陵墓，这分明是神仙洞府啊！】

    【我感觉林队他们再待一会儿，就要当场飞升了。】

    “大家注意，保持心神稳定，不要被周围的环境影响！”

    林薇立刻出声提醒。

    她虽然也为这种神奇的现象感到震惊，但多年的经验告诉她，越是看起来美好的东西，往往隐藏着越大的危险。

    队伍谨慎地向上行进，很快，他们便登上了祭坛的最高层。

    在这里，他们终于可以近距离地，毫无遮挡地，观察那口悬浮在光柱中的玉棺。

    当镜头给到玉棺近景特写的时候，新一轮的惊呼声再次响彻了全网。

    那口玉棺，比远看时更加令人震撼。

    它大约三米长，一米宽，通体由温润洁白的玉石雕琢而成，表面流淌着淡淡的七彩宝光。

    整个棺体看不到一毫的拼接痕迹，是天然生成的一块神玉。

    更让人惊奇的是，玉棺的表面，并非光滑的，而是刻满了无数细密如发丝的古老符文。

    这些符文，与青铜门上和祭坛上的都不相同，它们更加古老，更加玄奥，充满了道韵天成的美感。

    它们是活的，在玉棺表面缓缓流转，与周围的星辉交相辉映，构成了一幅神秘而壮丽的画卷。

    “这……这是……先秦古篆！”

    演播厅里，一直沉默的金世昌和张建国两位老教授，在看到这些符文的瞬间，几乎是异口同声地惊呼了出来。

    “先秦古篆？！”
content_en:
Or is he "living" in this jade coffin in a way that we can't understand until today?

    She didn't dare to think about it anymore.

    "Get ready to approach the jade coffin."

    She gave perhaps the most difficult and exciting order in her life to the team members behind her.

    "Captain Lin Wei decided to get close to the jade coffin! This is a historic moment! We may be about to witness the revelation of a secret that has been passed down for thousands of years!"

    In the studio, host Bingbing's voice sounded a little high-pitched due to excitement.

    The hundreds of millions of viewers in front of the screen also held their breath at this moment, and even the barrages became much sparser.

    Everyone's hearts rose to their throats little by little as Lin Wei and the team members followed.

    That nine-story high platform has invisible magic power.

    As Team Lin and his team members climbed up step by step, the light around them became brighter and brighter, and the refreshing "life energy" in the air became stronger and stronger.

    The team members can even feel that some small wounds on their bodies are healing at a speed visible to the naked eye.

    【Fuck! Automatically restore blood! This place is amazing! 】

    [This is not a mausoleum, this is clearly a fairy cave! 】

    [I feel like Captain Lin and the others will ascend on the spot if they stay a little longer. 】

    "Everyone, please pay attention, keep your mind stable and don't be affected by the surrounding environment!"

    Lin Wei immediately reminded him.

    Although she was also shocked by this magical phenomenon, years of experience told her that the more beautiful something looks, the greater the danger it often hides.

    The procession moved upward cautiously, and soon they reached the highest level of the altar.

    Here, they could finally observe the jade coffin suspended in the beam of light up close and without any obstruction.

    When the camera showed a close-up of the jade coffin, a new round of exclamations resounded throughout the entire network again.

    That jade coffin is even more shocking than when seen from a distance.

    It is about three meters long and one meter wide. The whole body is carved from warm and white jade, with a faint colorful light flowing on the surface.

    There is no trace of splicing in the entire coffin. It is a naturally occurring piece of sacred jade.

    What's even more surprising is that the surface of the jade coffin is not smooth, but is instead engraved with countless ancient runes as fine as hair.

    These runes are different from those on the bronze door and the altar. They are older, more mysterious, and full of the natural beauty of Taoism.

    They are alive, flowing slowly on the surface of the jade coffin, complementing the surrounding stars, forming a mysterious and magnificent picture.

    "This...this is...pre-Qin ancient seal script!"

    In the studio, two old professors, Jin Shichang and Zhang Jianguo, who had been silent, almost exclaimed in unison when they saw these runes.

    "Pre-Qin ancient seal script?!"
